mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5.25% in a single month reduces near-term discounting of corporate cash flows, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat when FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25%, or inflation proxies (CPIAUCSL) show no acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 146,500 monthly suggests labor market strength that supports equity risk appetite and drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when PAYEMS remains above 146,500 during a non-expansionary regime (UNRATE > 5%).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the HOUST index (industrial production) of more than 3% for two consecutive months predicts a supply-side shock that depresses equity valuations, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 3% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when the decline in HOUST is not accompanied by a parallel drop in UNRATE or INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the INDPRO index (suppliers' activity) above its 12-month moving average signals production capacity expansion that supports optimism and positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate > 2% m/m over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not statistically different from zero when INDPRO acceleration persists but GDP growth is flat.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both GDPC1 (consumer demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 10% in the same quarter indicate weakening demand, which predicts negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < -10% and RSAFS < -10% in the same quarter
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when GDPC1 and RSAFS declines are not concurrent or are less severe.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in UNRATE below 4% over 6 months indicates labor market slack that reduces equity risk premium and yields negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive when UNRATE remains above 4% during the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 6% in a single month coincides with higher discount rates applied to equities, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 6% but CPIAUCSL shows no acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 250 (inflation acceleration) combined with a decline in INDPRO suggests cost pressures outweigh production gains, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 250 and INDPRO < 105 in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when CPIAUCSL acceleration persists but INDPRO shows robust growth.
